arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo TLS_CHECK_START=1
B=lowcost-europa.duckdns.org
set +e
v="$(curl -sS --max-time 18 -o /dev/null -w 'https_code=%{http_code};ssl_verify=%{ssl_verify_result};connect=%{time_connect};tls=%{time_appconnect}' "https://$B/")"
rc=$?
set -e
echo "TLS_STRICT=$v;CURL_EXIT=$rc"
set +e
http="$(curl -sS --max-time 18 -D - -o /dev/null "http://$B/" | tr -d '\r' | grep -Ei '^(HTTP/|location:)' | head -4)"
h_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'HTTP_TO_HTTPS_HEADERS=%s;CODE=%s\n' "$http" "$h_rc"
for f in product-images.js catalog-explorer.js; do
 code="$(curl -sS --max-time 18 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://$B/static/storefront/$f" || true)"
 echo "STATIC=$f;HTTP=$code"
done
if command -v openssl >/dev/null; then
 echo | openssl s_client -connect "$B:443" -servername "$B" -verify_return_error 2>&1 | grep -E '^Verification:|^Verify return code:' | head -3 || true
fi
echo TLS_CHECK_END=PASS

set -Eeuo pipefail
echo SOURCE_STATIC_CHECK_START=1
cd /srv/lowcost-europa
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "8b8bdaeaeb49f01def64b127f1b0c1459d5cf24e" && echo STAGING_SHA=PASS
for f in apps/storefront/static/storefront/product-images.js apps/storefront/static/storefront/catalog-explorer.js; do
 if test -s "$f"; then echo "JS_FILE=$f;PRESENT=YES"; else echo "JS_FILE=$f;PRESENT=NO"; fi
 if command -v node >/dev/null; then
  node --check "$f" && echo "JS_SYNTAX=$f;PASS" || echo "JS_SYNTAX=$f;FAIL"
 fi
done
echo SOURCE_STATIC_CHECK_END=PASS
